items: Tajurbe ke darja hararat par munasib solvent mein madde ka saturated solution tayyar karein.

Garam saturated solution ko filter kar ke na-halne wali na-pakiyan hatayein; yeh filter paper ya funnel ki nali mein qabl az waqt crystallization se bachata hai, zaroorat ho to hot-water funnel istemal karte hue.
Garam filtered solution ko darmiyani raftar se thanda karein taake darmiyane size ke crystals banein.
Jab crystallization mukammal ho to crystals aur mother liquor ke mixture ko vacuum pump ke saath Gooch crucible se filter karein.

Crystals hawa mein ya oven mein sukhayein, oven sirf tab jab madda 100 degrees C par pighle ya toote nahi. Mehfooz, qabil-e-bharosa tareeqa vacuum desiccator hai: crystals watch glass par phaila kar CaCl2, silica gel ya phosphorus pentoxide jaise sukhane wale madde par desiccator mein kai ghante rakhe jate hain.

blocks.text: Rangeen ya resin jaisi na-pakiyan jo product ki shakal bigarti hain, madde ko solvent mein bareek pise janwari charcoal ke saath ubal kar aur garam filter kar ke hatai jati hain: rangeen na-pakiyan charcoal par adsorb hoti hain aur be-rang madda thanda hone par filtrate se crystallize hota hai. Figure 15.5 silsila dikhati hai: na-halne wali na-paki ke saath ek solid ka solution, izafi solid filter kiya hua, garam liquid evaporating dish mein muntaqil aur saturated hone tak bhaap banaya hua, aur thanda hone par crystals bante hue.

blocks.prompt: Crystallization ke aham qadam batayein, aur kahein ke peeli jhalak wala khaam namoona kaise be-rang kiya jayega (Quick Check 15.2c).
blocks.explanation: Saturated garam solution banayein, use garam filter karein (hot-water funnel), aahista thanda karein, Gooch crucible mein suction se crystals mother liquor se filter karein, aur hawa, oven ya vacuum desiccator mein sukhayein. Rang solution ko thore janwari charcoal ke saath ubal kar hataya jata hai, jo rangeen na-paki adsorb karta hai, aur thanda karne se pehle garam filter kar ke.

items: Qadam: saturated garam solution; garam filtration; aahista thanda; Gooch crucible mein suction filtration; sukhana (hawa, 100 degrees C oven, CaCl2, silica gel ya P2O5 wala vacuum desiccator). Janwari charcoal rangeen na-pakiyan hatata hai.
